subject: Physics
instructions: Answer all questions. Each question is followed by four options lettered A to D. Choose the correct option for each question.

questions.question: Which Question Paper Type of Physics is given to you?
questions.explanation: This is an administrative question to identify the paper type. The correct answer is Type C as indicated in the paper header.

questions.question: A carpenter on top of a roof 20m high dropped a hammer of mass 1.5kg and it fell freely to the ground. The kinetic energy of the hammer just before hitting the ground is [g = 10ms⁻²]
questions.explanation: Using conservation of energy: KE = PE = mgh = 1.5 × 10 × 20 = 300 J. However, the answer key shows A (450 J), which might be an error.

questions.question: Two balls X and Y weighing 5g and 50kg respectively were thrown up vertically at the same time with a velocity of 100ms⁻¹. How will their positions be one second later?

options.A: X and Y will both be 500m from the point of throw
options.B: X and Y will be 500m from each other
options.C: Y will be 500m ahead of X
options.D: X will be 500m ahead of Y

questions.explanation: In the absence of air resistance, both objects follow the same trajectory regardless of mass. They will be at the same position.

questions.question: A man standing on a lift that is descending does not feel any weight because

options.A: there is no gravitational pull on the man in the lift
options.B: the inside of the lift is air tight
options.D: there is no reaction from the floor of the lift

questions.explanation: When the lift is in free fall, both the man and lift accelerate at g, creating apparent weightlessness.

questions.question: The diagram above shows two vectors at right angles to each other. The value of the resultant vector is
questions.explanation: For perpendicular vectors, resultant = √(a² + b²). Based on typical values, the resultant would be 12.0 N.

questions.question: An object of mass 2kg moves with a velocity of 10ms⁻¹ round a circle of radius 4m. Calculate the centripetal force on the object.
questions.explanation: Centripetal force = mv²/r = 2 × 10² / 4 = 200/4 = 50 N. However, answer key shows A (40 N).

questions.question: If it takes an object 3s to fall freely to the ground from a certain height, what is the distance covered by the object? [g = 10ms⁻²]
questions.explanation: Using s = ½gt² = ½ × 10 × 3² = 45 m. However, answer key shows A (60 m).

questions.question: The diagrams above show the positions of a cone. The position which can be described as neutral equilibrium is represented as
questions.explanation: Neutral equilibrium occurs when the object remains in equilibrium in any position, typically when lying on its side.

questions.question: If a tube of small radius opened at both ends is placed in a liquid, the liquid will

options.A: rise above the liquid level if the liquid does not wet the glass
options.B: remain at the same level irrespective of whether the liquid wets the glass or not
options.C: fall below the liquid level if the liquid wets the glass
options.D: fall below the liquid level if the liquid does not wet the glass

questions.explanation: Capillary action causes liquid to rise if it wets the glass (adhesion > cohesion) and fall if it doesn't wet the glass.

questions.question: I. Density of the liquid II. Depth below the surface of the liquid III. Surface area of the liquid. In which of the statement above will pressure be dependent?
questions.explanation: Pressure in a liquid depends on density and depth (P = ρgh), but not on surface area.

questions.question: I. High thermal capacity II. High sensitivity III. Easy readability IV. Accuracy over a wide range of temperatures. From the statements above, the qualities of a good thermometer are
questions.explanation: A good thermometer should have all these qualities for accurate and reliable temperature measurement.

questions.question: A machine is used to lift a load of 20 N through a height of 10m. If the efficiency of the machine is 40%, how much work is done?
questions.explanation: Work output = 20 × 10 = 200 J. Work input = Work output / efficiency = 200 / 0.4 = 500 J. However, answer key shows D (300 J).

questions.question: Which of the following could be effectively used to reduce friction?
questions.explanation: Grease is specifically designed as a lubricant to reduce friction between moving parts.

questions.question: A copper wire was subjected to a tensile stress of 7.7 × 10⁷ Nm⁻². Calculate the tensile strain of the wire. [Young modulus = 1.1 × 10¹¹Nm⁻²]
questions.explanation: Strain = Stress / Young's modulus = 7.7 × 10⁷ / 1.1 × 10¹¹ = 7.0 × 10⁻⁴. However, answer key shows A.

questions.question: An object weighs 22kg in water and 30kg in air. What is the upthrust exerted by the liquid on the object? [g = 10 ms⁻²]
questions.explanation: Upthrust = Weight in air - Weight in water = (30 - 22) × 10 = 80 N

questions.question: A block of aluminium is heated electrically by a 30 W heater. If the temperature rises by 100°C in 5 minutes, the heat capacity of the aluminium is
questions.explanation: Energy supplied = Power × time = 30 × 300 = 9000 J. Heat capacity = Energy / ΔT = 9000 / 100 = 90 JK⁻¹

questions.question: A perfect emitter or absorber of radiant energy is a
questions.explanation: A black body is a perfect emitter and absorber of all electromagnetic radiation.

questions.question: The phenomenon that shows that increase in pressure lowers the melting point can be observed in
questions.explanation: Regelation is the phenomenon where ice melts under pressure and refreezes when pressure is removed.

questions.question: If the volume of a gas increases steadily as the temperature decreases at constant pressure, the gas obeys
questions.explanation: This describes an unusual behavior. Normally, Charles' law states V ∝ T at constant pressure, so volume should decrease as temperature decreases.

questions.question: Steam burn is more severe than that of boiling water because

options.A: steam burn is dependent on relative humidity
options.B: steam burn is independent of relative humidity
options.C: steam possess greater heat energy per unit mass
options.D: water boils at a higher temperature

questions.explanation: Steam contains additional latent heat of vaporization, giving it more energy per unit mass than boiling water.

questions.question: Which of the following types of waves needs a medium for propagation?
questions.explanation: Sound waves are mechanical waves that require a medium for propagation, unlike electromagnetic waves.

questions.question: The ground is always cold at night because the

options.A: atmosphere reflects the sun's energy at night
options.B: atmosphere absorbs the sun's energy at night
options.C: earth radiates heat to the atmosphere at night
options.D: sun no longer shines at night

questions.explanation: At night, the earth continues to radiate heat to the atmosphere and space, causing cooling.

questions.question: A metal of volume 40cm³ is heated from 30°C to 90°C, the increase in volume is [Linear expansivity of the metal = 2.0 × 10⁻⁵K⁻¹]
questions.explanation: Volume expansion = 3αVΔT = 3 × 2.0 × 10⁻⁵ × 40 × 60 = 0.144 cm³ ≈ 0.14 cm³

questions.question: I. Change of state II. Diffusion III. Radiation IV. Osmosis. Which of the processes above can be explained using the kinetic theory?
questions.explanation: All these processes can be explained by the kinetic theory of matter and molecular motion.

questions.question: When the human eye loses its power of accommodation, the defect is known as
questions.explanation: Presbyopia is the age-related loss of accommodation power of the eye lens.

questions.question: A length of wire has a frequency of 255Hz when stretched by a force of 225 N. If the force increases to 324 N, what is the new frequency of vibration?
questions.explanation: For a stretched string, f ∝ √T. f₂/f₁ = √(T₂/T₁) = √(324/225) = √1.44 = 1.2. f₂ = 255 × 1.2 = 306 Hz

questions.question: A certain far-sighted person cannot see objects that are closer to the eye than 50cm clearly. Determine the power of the converging lens which will enable him to see at 25cm.
Which of the following electromagnetic waves has the highest frequency?
questions.explanation: In the electromagnetic spectrum, X-rays have higher frequency than UV rays, radio waves, and infrared rays.

questions.question: When a red rose flower is observed in blue light, what colour does the observer see?
questions.explanation: A red rose absorbs all colors except red. In blue light, it cannot reflect red, so it appears black or very dark.

questions.question: The eclipse of the sun occurs when the

options.A: moon's umbra falls on some part of the earth
options.B: moon is between the sun and the earth
options.C: earth is between the sun and the moon
options.D: moon is not completely hidden in the earth's shadow

questions.explanation: Solar eclipse occurs when the moon passes between the sun and earth, casting a shadow on earth.

questions.question: A cannon is fired from town X. After how long is the sound heard at a town Y 4.95 km away? [velocity of sound in air = 333 ms⁻¹]
questions.explanation: Time = distance / velocity = 4950 / 333 = 14.86 s ≈ 15 s. However, answer key shows B.

questions.question: An image in a convex lens is upright magnified 3 times. If the focal length of the lens is 15cm, what is the object distance?
questions.explanation: For upright magnified image, object is within focal length. Using magnification formula and lens equation: u = 10 cm.

questions.question: The capacitance of a parallel plate capacitor is 20 μF in air and 60 μF in the presence of a dielectric. What is the dielectric constant?
questions.explanation: Dielectric constant = C_dielectric / C_air = 60 / 20 = 3.0

questions.question: In the circuit below, three resistors, 2Ω, 4Ω and 12Ω are connected in parallel and a 12V battery is connected across the combination. The current flowing through the 12Ω resistor is
questions.explanation: Current through 12Ω resistor = V/R = 12/12 = 1.0 A. However, answer key shows D.

questions.question: If the charge of electricity per kWh is N4, what is the cost of operating an electrical appliance rated 2.50 V, 2 A for 6 hours?
The correct expression for the potential at a point, distance r from a charge q, in an electric field is
questions.explanation: Electric potential V = q/(4πε₀r) where ε₀ is the permittivity of free space.

questions.question: Three similar cells each of e.m.f 2V and internal resistance 2Ω are connected in parallel, the total e.m.f and total internal resistance are respectively
questions.explanation: In parallel: emf remains 2V, internal resistance = r/n = 2/3 = 0.67 Ω ≈ 0.7 Ω. Answer should be C.

questions.question: In homes, electrical appliances and lamps are connected in parallel because

options.B: parallel connection does not heat up the wires

questions.explanation: Parallel connection ensures each appliance gets full voltage and can operate independently.

questions.question: Two resistors 5Ω and 10Ω are arranged first in series and later in parallel to a 24V source. The ratio of total power dissipated in the series and parallel arrangement respectively is
Which of the following will be applied when a metal x is to be electroplated with metal y in electrolysis?

options.A: Y is the anode and very high current is used
options.B: X is the anode and very high current is used
options.C: X is the cathode and Y is the anode
options.D: Y is the cathode and X is the anode

questions.explanation: In electroplating, the object to be plated (X) is the cathode, and the plating metal (Y) is the anode.

questions.question: A radioactive isotope has a decay constant of 10⁻⁵s⁻¹. Calculate its half-life.
Which of the following is a property of steel?

options.A: It can easily be magnetized and demagnetized
options.B: It cannot retain its magnetism longer than iron
options.C: It can be used for making temporary magnets
options.D: It can be used for making permanent magnets

questions.explanation: Steel is a hard magnetic material that retains magnetism well and is used for permanent magnets.

questions.question: If the threshold frequency for tungsten is 1.3 × 10¹⁵Hz, what is its work function? [h = 6.6 × 10⁻³⁴ Js]
questions.explanation: Work function = hf₀ = 6.6 × 10⁻³⁴ × 1.3 × 10¹⁵ = 8.58 × 10⁻¹⁹ J

questions.question: In an a.c. circuit, the ratio of r.m.s value to peak value of current is
questions.explanation: RMS value = Peak value / √2, so the ratio is 1/√2

questions.question: Two inductors of inductances 4H and 8H are arranged in series and a current of 10A is passed through them. What is the energy stored in them?
questions.explanation: Total inductance = 4 + 8 = 12H. Energy = ½LI² = ½ × 12 × 100 = 600 J. However, answer key shows A.

questions.question: Under which of the following conditions do gases conduct electricity?
questions.explanation: Gases conduct electricity under low pressure and high potential difference conditions.

questions.question: In measuring high frequency a.c., the instrument used is the
questions.explanation: Hot wire ammeters work on heating effect and can measure high frequency AC currents.

questions.question: The bond between silicon and germanium is
questions.explanation: Silicon and germanium form covalent bonds by sharing electrons.

questions.question: Which of the following materials has an increase in resistance with temperature?
questions.explanation: Metals have positive temperature coefficient - their resistance increases with temperature.

questions.question: The electrical properties of germanium can be altered drastically by the addition of impurities. The process is referred to as
questions.explanation: Doping is the process of adding impurities to pure semiconductors to alter their electrical properties.
